title: Rate hedges: carry, basis, settlement timing, and accrued interest
objectives: Separate predictable bill carry from an unanticipated yield shock
Derive a rate hedge count with consistent price sensitivities and an ex ante projection coefficient
Explain deterministic-rate tailing through a complete dated settlement argument
Distinguish historical Eurodollar teaching from SOFR and clean quotation from dirty cash price
prerequisites: Bill quote and yield conventions from chapter 10; covariance projection from chapter 05; discount factors and futures marking to market.
source_scope: Full English captions for positions 26–28 read sequentially. Historical quotation language, discount-versus-simple-rate differences, and accrued-interest conventions are qualified. Synthetic arithmetic and proofs are independently constructed; no comprehensive audiovisual audit.
